### [`client-messages.ts`](../../i18n/client-messages.ts)

- `pickMessages` _function_: Narrows a message tree to the given namespaces, keeping key paths so `useTranslations('seo.faq')` still resolves. An entry is a top-level namespace or a dotted path such as `'contribute.form'`; one that does not exist is skipped.
- `mergeMessages` _function_: Deep-merges a delta onto a base message tree, returning a new object. A plain spread would let a route's `parks` replace the layout's `parks.status`, which next-intl reports only at render time as MISSING_MESSAGE.

### [`config.ts`](../../i18n/config.ts)

- `generateAlternateLanguages` _function_: Builds the absolute hreflang alternates, one per locale, from a path template.
- `isValidLocale` _function_: Check if a string is a valid locale
- `locales` _const_: The locales and their names, the one list every other file reads. A new language needs an entry here, in `localeNames` and a `messages/{locale}.json`.
- `defaultLocale` _const_
- `SITE_URL` _const_
- `localeNames` _const_
- `localeToOpenGraphLocale` _const_: Mapping of app locales to Open Graph locales (underscore format)
- Types: `Locale`

### [`no-prefetch-link.tsx`](../../i18n/no-prefetch-link.tsx)

- `Link` _component_: App-wide Link with route prefetching off unless `prefetch={true}`. Viewport and hover prefetch on long lists (a park's attraction cards, hub grids) generates and writes an ISR shell per link that is mostly never visited.

### [`request.ts`](../../i18n/request.ts)

- `default` _const_

### [`route-messages-provider.tsx`](../../i18n/route-messages-provider.tsx)

- `RouteMessagesProvider` _component_: Layers a route's namespaces onto the ones already in context, merging on the client so a shared set is serialized once. A nested provider replaces messages instead of merging them, so the delta is merged with `useMessages()` first.
- `useProvidedNamespaces` _hook_: Namespaces reachable from the nearest provider.
- `isNamespaceProvided` _function_: True when `namespace` is covered by an entry in `provided` (or one of its ancestors).

### [`route-messages.tsx`](../../i18n/route-messages.tsx)

- `RouteMessages` _component_: Adds the namespaces a route's client components need on top of the layout's chrome set. `pnpm check:client-messages` fails when a route that needs a delta does not render it, and when one that needs nothing still does.

### [`routing.ts`](../../i18n/routing.ts)

- `routing` _const_
- Types: `Locale`

### [`use-lazy-messages.ts`](../../i18n/use-lazy-messages.ts)

- `useLazyMessages` _hook_: Fetches message namespaces that the current route does not already ship, so a section such as `FavoritesSection` keeps them out of every visitor's payload on `/blog`.
- Types: `LazyMessagesResult`
